market_us.headline: US resume, early career
market_us.why: The US resume is one page and it is not a CV. No photo, no date of birth, no marital status, no nationality — all four are illegal or near-illegal for an employer to consider, so including them marks you out as foreign. Dates are month/year, spelling is American, and the word 'CV' means an academic document.

market_uk.headline: UK CV, first proper role

market_de.headline: The German tabular CV

Every school and every gap is accounted for; an unexplained period reads as concealment rather than as private business.

market_jp.headline: The Japanese standard-form CV
market_jp.why: The rirekisho is unlike anything else here: it is a prescribed form, not a document you design. Education and employment are one continuous chronological table starting from middle school, entries are formulaic rather than persuasive, and the motivation section carries the weight that bullet points carry elsewhere.
